episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Just when the high-schooler shaman Seong-a is getting bored with life, handsome Gyeon-u walks into her shrine upside-down. But he's destined to die?

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Seong-a hangs around Gyeon-u even when he's suspected of arson. Another fire breaks out, and Seong-a jumps into the flames. All for one reason!

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Seong-a's the only one by Gyeon-u's side at the funeral. Her mission as a human amulet begins! Holding hands, linking arms - all to fend off the evil!

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: "Let's stay moist," Weird love confession, but the heart flutters! But what if Seong-a's biggest secret is tied with Gyeon-u's deepest wound?

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Gyeon-U loses trust in Seong-A when he realizes she's something he hates the most. Seong-A loses her human amulet power and wounds open up.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Seong-A finds out Yeomhwa relished Gyeon-U's suffering. Seong-A decides to take Yeomhwa head on to save Gyeon-U while he comes across her past online.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: What? Gyeon-U is an evil spirit? Bong-su takes over Gyeon-U's body, wreaking havoc. But Gyeon-U himself pops out whenever his hand touches Seong-A's!

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Gyeon-U and Seong-A's relationship is a secret at school! The relationship's more exorcism than love, but at a crucial moment, he confesses his love!

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Seong-A cheers Gyeon-U on, and he wins gold. But then Seong-A falls ill. Gyeon-U decides to care for her, only for Bong-su to get in the way.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: People grow to like the new Gyeon-U, who's actually Bong-su. Bong-su realizes he wants to become human, and Seong-A decides to protect him.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Seong-A leaves everyone to protect Bong-su while Gyeon-U goes out every night for three years to find her. They reunite, but Seong-A has changed.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: Gyeon-U believes he met Seong-A, but it's Bong-su that he kissed? The new, delinquent Seong-A returns. The three people's real story begins now.
